purpose: Evaluate ranking of nonadditive, multiscale relation programs without using held-out labels in proposal or model scoring.

candidate_bank.construction: deterministic vocabulary-only stratified sampling; no target values, support association, query rows, truth labels, or literature annotations
strata: cross_modal: at least one molecular and one morphology operand
spatial_context: at least one own and one non-own spatial transform with distinct base quantities
conditional_multiscale: three or four operands containing a spatial transform and at least two biological measurement families
candidate_bank.legality: distinct base quantities; max two operands from one source family; all operands named and reportable

methods.morpheus: frozen composer scores every candidate program from support inputs only
methods.ebm: main-effect importance over exactly the compiled program-feature columns
methods.gbm: support-only permutation importance over exactly the compiled program-feature columns
methods.random: seeded uniform ranking of the identical program bank

hidden_evaluator.primary_label: positive held-out full-program gain beyond known-biology baseline AND positive held-out gain beyond the strongest proper-subset decomposition
hidden_evaluator.stability_requirement: patient-bootstrap lower confidence bound above zero and nonnegative gain in the prespecified majority of held-out patients

inference: paired bootstrap over episodes, with patient-within-episode resampling for certified labels; no candidate-level independence assumption
interpretation: This is a diagnostic evaluation of a frozen model. Its labels never enter current-model training. If it motivates retraining, the untouched historical and blind cohorts remain prohibited from all training, selection, and tuning.
